public_rationale: On October 22, 2026, TechCrunch reported that OpenAI was working on another private funding round ahead of a prospective IPO [e1]. That report establishes neither survival through 2030 nor fulfillment of the relevant obligations or a completed IPO [e1]. It provides no completed 2026-to-2030 revenue comparison or evidence that approximately tenfold growth was necessary [e1].
limitations: The packet lacks comparable realized annual revenue for 2026 and 2030.
Interim fundraising does not settle the claimed requirement.
The exact original projection report is unavailable, leaving its attribution unverified.
The contract uses annual revenue for the baseline, but the statement's word 'now' could mean a revenue run rate.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: For OpenAI to meet its obligations, survive or go public, it must grow revenue roughly tenfold by end of 2030.
conditions: to meet obligations, survive, or go public
public_payload.original_horizon_text: between now and the end of 2030

statement.excerpt: For any of these things to happen, OpenAI will have to grow at a staggering pace, and effectively (per The Information’s reported projections) 10x its revenue between now and the end of 2030.

from_speaker: For any of these things to happen
between now and the end of 2030
our_interpretation: Assess the main assertion as a conditional requirement for survival, fulfillment of obligations, or an IPO, rather than merely checking the arithmetic of reported projections.

Use realized calendar-year 2030 revenue against realized calendar-year 2026 revenue. The surrounding annual projections make this a reasonable reading, but 'now' could instead mean a current run rate.
'Effectively 10x' means approximately tenfold, without inventing a precise tolerance.
Survival means continued operation through the horizon. Paying some current bills is not fulfillment of all the obligations invoked.
The attribution to The Information is a separate historical component. Correctly describing projections would not establish the necessity of achieving them.
criteria.support_condition: At least one specified business outcome occurs within the relevant period, revenue grows approximately tenfold on a consistent basis, and evidence establishes that this growth was necessary rather than merely coincident.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A specified business outcome is achieved and the completed 2030 comparison shows revenue materially below tenfold growth. Earlier revenue below the threshold alone cannot refute an end-2030 requirement.
